evidence_status: Thresholds are review safeguards for a prototype, not empirically validated lending cut-offs.

component_rationale.savings_ratio: A sustained positive surplus supports affordability, but does not prove repayment performance.
component_rationale.emi_burden: Existing and proposed repayment burden is checked against recognised recurring income.
component_rationale.salary_consistency: Repeated income evidence reduces uncertainty but is not employment verification.
component_rationale.expense_stability: High variation can indicate uncertain cash flow; it must not be used alone to decide a case.
component_rationale.utility_regularity: A descriptive continuity indicator only; missing utilities must not be interpreted as poor credit behaviour.
component_rationale.data_quality: Low-quality or incomplete evidence triggers review rather than an adverse conclusion.
